This is a game of Werewolf with 5 players: 1 Seer, 1 Werewolf, 1 Possessed, and 2 Villagers. Participants: Ryuji, Toshio, Mizuki, Kenji and Sakura. Each player's role is secret.
- Seer: a human who divines one player each night and learns whether that player is human or a werewolf.
- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Toshio, Kenji, Mizuki, Ryuji and Sakura. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day). An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

| 1 | the Seer is told the result of the night-0 divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | every living player votes; the player with the most votes is executed | the Seer divines one other living player; the Werewolf attacks one other living player |
